verdict.rationale: Supermemory offers a self-hosted binary option ("data never leaves the building") and lists SOC2/HIPAA BAA/self-hosted as compliance options, which lets an org control the physical location of data by running it on their own infrastructure, but there is no documented feature to choose a specific region/data-residency setting within the hosted SaaS offering itself. missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection controls in the hosted product, documentation of where hosted data is stored geographically, and any multi-region deployment options.
